mapper.sql: p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.main_image, p.images, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.sales_count, p.status, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.main_image, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.sales_count, p.status, p.created_at FROM products p WHERE p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.main_image, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.sales_count, p.status, p.created_at FROM products p WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.main_image, p.images, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.sales_count, p.status, p.created_at, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.parent_id AS c_parent_id, c.sort_order AS c_sort_order, sku.id AS sku_id, sku.product_id AS sku_product_id, sku.sku_code AS sku_code, sku.color AS sku_color, sku.size AS sku_size, sku.price AS sku_price, sku.image_url AS sku_image_url, sku.weight AS sku_weight FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_skus sku ON p.id = sku.product_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.main_image, p.images, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.sales_count, p.status, p.created_at, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.parent_id AS c_parent_id, c.sort_order AS c_sort_order FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET sales_count = sales_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{productId}
